root_cause_evidence: Source diff shows no prior rankings MCP route and adds a generic ranking provider. Previous v1 broad research coverage gaps motivated a generic coverage-first ordering rule; this review does not convert those historical observations into v2 acceptance.
applicable_scope: Server-side Chat public WCL catalog and DPS/HPS/bossDPS leaderboard discovery, bounded page/offset processing, report identity handoff and truthful research coverage across arbitrary supported classes/specs/encounters.
